summary: Canadian Solar Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a Notice of Annual Meeting of Shareholders and a Management Information Circular for its upcoming annual meeting. The document sets forth routine meeting agenda items including the receipt of audited financial statements, election of directors, appointment of auditors, and authorization of director compensation. No special situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or going-private is presented. The filing is a routine administrative filing required of a foreign private issuer, not a special-situations event.
